title: Stop LazyCop from asking the same question twice and keep the card queue short

outcome: LazyCop generates repeated spec-check cards for the same quote across cards in one session, and end_session re-asks points the developer already answered.

A spec-check card is not shown when a card with the same quote was already shown in this session (answered or not); a confirm card gets no spec check when the correction it confirms was the developer picking the spec reading; end_session drops assumptions that match a card the developer already answered in this session; when Bob declares a new assumption, older unanswered before-an-edit and checking-your-correction cards, and their spec checks, become stale and leave the page; the page removes stale cards via a new SSE event typed in packages/contracts.
forbid: no change to how answers reach Bob (parallel, at his next step), to holds, or to the mission report
follow docs/reference/architecture.md — especially invariant 3 (every wait ends) and invariant 4 (page is view-only)

evidence: All 171 tests pass (npm test). Typecheck clean. Gate 0 clean. specCheck deduplicates by quote via shownQuotes; confirm-of-spec suppressed via confirmForPick; end_session filters against answeredClaims; markStale emits stale SSE removing unanswered declare_step/confirm cards and their spec-check children (hold card and new card exempt); view.ts drops stale card ids from view.cards; SseStaleEvent added to contracts.

disposition: Shipped: spec-check dedup by quote, confirm-of-spec suppression, end_session dedup against answered claims, stale-card eviction with new SseStaleEvent, page drops stale cards.
